lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Good, you're still here. The release is at 8:30 tomorrow.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Tomorrow morning? What is left on the list?

lines.text: Eight open bugs. Small ones. Mostly.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: I'm sure you'll be fine. The building gets noisy after midnight. Old wiring.

lines.text: The coffee is fresh. Whatever you hear, finish the fix first.

lines.speaker: BOSS
lines.text: Goodnight. The lights run on a timer.
